# Synthetic printability torture suite

Linear issue: `24K-30`

These files are generated by `src/image23mf/quality/synthetic_fixtures.py`; do not edit the PNGs or
catalog manually. Regenerate them from the repository root with:

```bash
make fixtures
```

The suite intentionally has no font or platform-rendering dependency. Primitive geometry is drawn
at 4× resolution and downsampled for deterministic anti-alias coverage. The catalog records both
the PNG hash and the decoded RGBA pixel hash.

## Coverage

- `geometry-nozzle-020.png` — dots, rings, holes, necks, long lines, anti-aliased slopes, and
  boundary-clipped components on a 51.2 × 38.4 mm canvas calibrated for a 0.2 mm nozzle.
- `geometry-nozzle-040.png` — the same physical measurements on a 102.4 × 76.8 mm canvas calibrated
  for a 0.4 mm nozzle, changing the pixel representation without changing the intended millimeters.
- `boundary-transparency.png` — fully transparent, partially transparent, anti-aliased, and
  edge-crossing shapes used by extreme crop cases.
- `palette-degeneracy.png` — exact/near dark and light colors, close orange hues, and dense grayscale
  boundaries for stable tie-breaking.

`catalog.json` also defines single-pixel, edge-strip, transparent-only, negative-origin, and
outside-extent crops, plus single, duplicate, near-tie, and over-limit palette configurations. All
physical measurements are data, not labels burned into the pixels, so tests can measure the images
without OCR or font variance.
